Profile Piromidic acid is a 4-quinolone antibacterial with properties sim- ilar to those of nalidixic acid (p.303). It has been used in the treat- ment of susceptible infections. There have been a number of re- ports of acute renal failure associated with piromidic acid. Preparations Proprietary Preparations (details are given in Part 3) Ital.: Enteromix†.
